title: Media Monitoring & Press Release Pickup Tracking | PressCosmos
description: Track press release pickup across 180,000+ sources in real time with sentiment scoring, journalist alerts, competitive share of voice and a live pickup map.
body:
1. Home
  2. Services
  3. Media Monitoring

Service

Watch where your story actually landed — as it happens.

You sent it to 300 desks. Twelve of them carried it in the first hour. Which twelve, in which metros, with what tone, and who else reported the same story that morning?

Add monitoring to a releaseSee reporting
Quick answer PressCosmos media monitoring tracks press release pickup across 180,000+ sources in near real time. It reports which outlets carried the release, the sentiment and tone of coverage, referral traffic, journalist and outlet alerts, and competitive share of voice against named rivals.

Live pickup map

Every outlet plotted geographically, filterable by vertical and tier, updating as pickups are detected. Useful for planning the next metro you target and for showing a regional sales team exactly where their market responded.

Detection begins at publication, not the next business morning.

Sentiment and tone

Coverage scored for sentiment, with the specific sentence that drove the score highlighted so you can quote it in your report.

Journalist alerts

Get notified when a specific writer, desk or beat picks up your story — or covers a competitor in your category.

Share of voice

Compare your coverage volume and sentiment against up to five named competitors over any date range.

Crisis triggers

Alert thresholds on negative sentiment spikes, with a one-click path into the crisis publishing lane.

Coverage beyond your own releases

Monitoring is not limited to PressCosmos distribution. Track competitor announcements, category keywords, executive names and regulatory terms across the open web so you know what your market is reading on the day you plan to announce.

In practice

How comms teams use the feed

During a launch

Confirm which tier really drove coverage, then shift paid amplification toward the metros that responded.

In a weekly report

Export coverage volume, sentiment trend and top outlets as a one-page summary for leadership.

In a crisis

Detect the first negative pickup within minutes and trigger the standby editor before it spreads.

Get started

Stop guessing which outlets ran it.

Monitoring is included on every plan, with deeper historical and competitor tracking on Amplify and above.
